question: Which permitted primary public sources give a fusion Nb3Sn cable-in-conduit conductor and winding-pack construction (strand count and diameter, copper to non-copper ratio, void fraction, jacket, insulation and cooling-channel dimensions), its operating current, peak field and temperature, cabling or effective-strain degradation and current-sharing-temperature margin, sufficient to convert strand performance into conductor and winding-pack engineering current density?
